The served packet's own committed admission record PREDATES the fix, so a rebuild would carry the warning; whether to rebuild is Product's decision, not this lane's.
critical_findings.counter_authority_is_essentially_absent_: NEGATIVE RESULT OF RECORD. 5 counter-authority labels across 642 served decisions (0.78%): de-kapitalverletzung 2, it-responsabilita-medica 3, fr-bail-entretien ZERO. Every issued label is supported (evidence present + uncertainty present) and every one sits beyond rank 50. This is the opposite of a pass for the product's counter-authority capability.
critical_findings.the_answer_cites_no_counter_authority_at: SHARPEST FINDING. The served answers cite 4 (de) + 6 (fr) + 5 (it) = 15 decisions and NOT ONE of them is a decision the product itself labelled limiting or contrary. The product's core promise is answer PLUS explicit contrary authority; on the served bytes the answer half never grounds itself in the counter half. Measured on the served bytes, mapping-free.
critical_findings.the_counter_evidence_contract_is_unexerc: 2 of 15 mutation controls did not fire, both on fr-bail-entretien and both classified UNEXERCISED_POPULATION_EMPTY: that bundle emits zero rows in the accepted COUNTER_STATUSES set, so blanking counter_evidence and counter_uncertainty had nothing to mutate. Its support_rate_among_issued is null, NOT 1.0. Run exit code 2 ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS is the frozen rule's mandate for a control that did not fire; the CAUSE is a product negative result and is published, not smoothed behind the generic verdict.
critical_findings.run_exit_is_2_not_0: The run verdict is ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS with exit 2, and NO claim of a clean pass is made anywhere. Exit 0 would have required all 15 controls to fire; 2 could not, for the reason above. The frozen success rule was NOT weakened to obtain a green verdict.
critical_findings.the_aggregate_implements_the_frozen_per_: An earlier build of the instrument required HANDOFF_PASS on all three qids. That is STRICTER than the frozen rule, which reads '(a) the BEFORE arm fires the predicate on at least one qid' and then requires (c)/(d)/(e) only 'on every qid where BEFORE had a non-empty under-covered set'. The instrument was corrected to the frozen rule as written BEFORE the formal run; the correction is disclosed here and in tests/evaluation/test_product_served_bundle_falsification.py. No benchmark was tightened after seeing results.
